# Architecture Recommendation

Based on the stated constraints, I recommend a **microservices architecture deployed on a managed cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)** with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for scalability and cost efficiency. This approach prioritizes maintainability through service isolation and independent deployment cycles, while optimizing costs via auto-scaling and pay-as-you-go pricing models. Use managed services (databases, message queues, monitoring) to reduce operational overhead and further enhance cost-efficiency.
